test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Given below are two letter-cluster pairs in which the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster following a certain logic. Select the letter-cluster pair from among the options that follows the same logic. 

CPG : PGC

TJM : JMT
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2775864c411b7b7effeab2b3c0808ee3cbf3ef1c3cedf2a7c11a799aea2bcd2e.png] 

Given:

CPG : PGC and TJM : JMT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b913bcf2e6d1cf729a4d037ad2caf6b2a4840c1303c294fe19d9a0b92a7f748c.png] 

 and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08d110c9a494ac317515679fa2b29c0ee215334587da230caad8512762fc08f2.png] 

Let's check all the options are:

1) UQK : QKU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fd201ac213a3bc34d453f803555d5e32129a9755d9f0af7fd53af5dac93fda0.png] 

2) UQK : KQU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0430b49105a3803663a847135fea8868b2f46b28d8984335e38c85e6260cb1ad.png] 

3) UQK : QKV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b76eb52a5df3d134c28e00eec97f70d308628d23f367cdfb8cf67ea06e0e65c.png] 

4) UQK : QUK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80fb8d31a83efcd6d354741c2c3ee2b05c6f3bc2dd7f79a7d70e7070e06bb2b.png] 

Thus, the pair **UQK : QKU **follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is '__option 1__'.
